role: academic-paper revision peer_reviewer: substantive method and data audit
decision: Suitable basis for exploratory single-deployment cases plus bounded behavioral probes; insufficient for architecture-level causal or general-effect claims

hard_gaps_not_fixable_by_prose: Two of eight fixtures invalid, posthoc repairs not holdout
No team liveness or end-to-end outcome
No no-name condition or lexical-set replication
Constructed exact metadata filtering, not retrieval benchmark
Two of eight action-label oracles invalid
Explicit protocol predetermines proposed recovery principles
No counterfactual code/contract cost or end-to-end outcome
Rule positive/negative cases differ in task and joint interventions

findings.issue: P1-P4 explicit protocols state principles later interpreted; behavior probes are not independent validation of those principles or architectures
findings.fixable_by_prose: Narrow contribution and classify experiments as conditional protocol-following probes
findings.requires_new_research: Yes for spontaneous long-run ownership, actual workflow/graph intervention, or retrieval effectiveness

findings.issue: Purposive windows, repeated agents/versions, one deployment and overlapping evidence cannot support incidence or population effects
findings.fixable_by_prose: Define analytic population, selection logic and level of inference
findings.requires_new_research: Yes for exposure rates, cross-deployment effects or learning curves

findings.issue: P2 W2/W8 and P4 D5/D8 each invalidate 2/8 scenario families; posthoc same-fixture repairs do not supply independent validation
findings.fixable_by_prose: Keep original, excluded and repaired analyses distinct; no negative attribution from defective fixtures
findings.requires_new_research: Independent content review and held-out families

findings.issue: Same AI generates tasks, expected answers, selections and interpretation; no independent factual/coding adjudication
findings.fixable_by_prose: Disclose scope and explicit observable criteria; do not invent agreement statistics
findings.requires_new_research: Separate verification of cases and ground truth

findings.issue: Local raw/derived provenance is extensive but absolute paths and private data do not provide public independent reproduction
findings.fixable_by_prose: Separate local recalculation, public reproduction, and historical causal reconstruction
findings.requires_new_research: Shareable redacted evidence bundle and environment contract

not_applicable: Questionnaire reliability/validity: no questionnaire was conducted
Linear regression misspecification: no regression was fitted
Selective significance reporting: no inferential significance tests, all original responses and mismatches preserved
strengths: Original raw results and negative evidence retained
Posthoc audit and repair analyses labeled
Known system bugs and legal waits distinguished
Scenario and repeated-response denominators generally identified
not_performed: No external literature verification by this role
